title: Bhupesh Baghel questions exit poll reliability, says 'wait and see'
description: Former Chhattisgarh CM Bhupesh Baghel expressed skepticism about exit poll reliability, advising to 'wait and see' for the May 4 vote count. This follows surveys predicting varied outcomes across West Bengal, Assam, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu.

title: 'Keralam Exit Polls Are 200% Right': Congress Leader Shama Mohamed Expresses Confidence Over UDF Comeback In State - VIDEO
description: Congress leader Shama Mohamed said Kerala exit polls are “200% right” despite many predictions failing in past elections. She expressed confidence in the Congress-led UDF returning to power and said the DMK-Congress alliance would win Tamil Nadu. She also criticised the electoral process in West Bengal, alleging voter disenfranchisement.

title: Election Commission to retain 700 CAPF companies in West Bengal
description: The Election Commission of India will retain 700 Central Armed Police Forces in West Bengal for security after assembly polls amid TMC criticism.
